claims: Continue pantoprazole 40 mg IV for stress ulcer prophylaxis.
Continue epoetin alfa and ferric gluconate for anemia management.
Continue folic acid and cyanocobalamin supplementation.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit for anemia (Hgb 9.6-10.2 g/dL, Hct 27.6-28.5%).
Monitor blood pressure given intermittent diastolic elevation (e.g., 126 mmHg) and antihypertensive alarms.
Monitor renal function and electrolytes (creatinine 1.1 mg/dL, BUN 21 mg/dL, potassium 3.9 mEq/L).
Monitor coagulation status (INR 1.2, PT 13.1 s, PTT 33 s).
Assess and address inadequate nutrition per Braden nutrition score of 2.
Maintain fall precautions and mobility assessment given bedfast/chairfast status and weak gait.
Maintain continuous pulse oximetry and cardiac monitoring with alarms (SpO2 desat limit 88%, ST segment monitoring on).
